objs.name: document
objs.description: A document that undergoes creation, editing, review, and release processes in the P&R management system

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The category of document such as Policy, Guideline, Work Instruction, or Procedural Instruction

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current state of the document in its lifecycle

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The version number of the document

attributes.name: valid_until_date
attributes.description: The expiration date of document validity

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which the document is valid

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: The primary creator of the document

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Additional creators with write permissions

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Person responsible for technical and formal review

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Person responsible for final approval and release

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: User groups or persons with read access

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document that is automatically released with the main document and subject to its own versioning

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The release status of the attachment

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The version number of the attachment

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: Supplementary document content not subject to release cycle of the main document

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The kind of additional information such as brief instructions or screenshots

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal to amend an existing document without affecting its content or version history

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The processing status of the change proposal

attributes.name: scheduled_implementation
attributes.description: Whether the proposal is planned for implementation

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated request to check if a document requires validity extension or revision

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The processing status of the validity extension request

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to invalidate a document that has no additional validity

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The processing status of the override request

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to re-validate a previously invalidated document

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The processing status of the reactivation request

objs.name: user
objs.description: A person with assigned roles and permissions in the system

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: The assigned role such as Author, Reviewer, Releaser, or Reader

attributes.name: user_group
attributes.description: The group to which the user belongs

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A collection of users with shared permissions and access rights

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The identifier for the user group

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The kind of user group such as Reader or Archive

objs.name: translation
objs.description: A language-dependent version of a released document

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: The language of the translated version

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The release status of the translation

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of users and user groups who receive access or notifications for a document

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Whether distribution is by email or for acknowledgement

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Initial creation of a new document with selection of document type and template

attributes.name: document_type_selected
attributes.description: The type of document being created

evts.name: edit_document
evts.description: Modification of document content or metadata properties

attributes.name: content_changed
attributes.description: Indicates if document content was modified

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: Setting or updating standardized and customer-specific metadata and attributes

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: The grouping category of metadata being maintained

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatic conversion of edited document to PDF format

attributes.name: format
attributes.description: The output format after conversion

evts.name: upload_attachment
evts.description: Addition of an Attachment document to a main document

evts.name: add_additional_information
evts.description: Addition of supplementary information to a document without affecting release cycle

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Proposal to amend a document initiated by an author with write access

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Electronic signature by workflow participant during release process

attributes.name: signature_type
attributes.description: The role performing the signature such as Author, Reviewer, or Releaser

evts.name: initiate_review
evts.description: Start of the review workflow step for document approval

attributes.name: reviewer_count
attributes.description: The number of reviewers assigned

evts.name: complete_review
evts.description: Completion of technical and formal review of document

attributes.name: review_result
attributes.description: Whether review was approved or rejected

evts.name: initiate_release
evts.description: Start of the release workflow step for final document approval

attributes.name: releaser_count
attributes.description: The number of releasers assigned

evts.name: complete_release
evts.description: Final approval and release of document making it available to readers

attributes.name: release_result
attributes.description: Whether release was approved or rejected

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatic publication of document to readers upon release

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: Creation of a new editing version when revising a released document

attributes.name: reason
attributes.description: The reason for creating new version such as content change or property change

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Marking of an Attachment for archiving when no longer relevant to new version

evts.name: request_validity_extension
evts.description: System-generated request when document reaches 30 days before validity expiration

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Approval of validity extension updating the valid until date

attributes.name: new_validity_period
attributes.description: The extended validity period in years

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: User creation of request to invalidate a document with no additional validity

evts.name: approve_override
evts.description: Confirmation of document invalidation and archiving after workflow steps

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: The period for which document is archived before physical deletion

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Creation of request to re-validate a previously invalidated document

evts.name: approve_reactivation
evts.description: Confirmation of reactivation creating new version of previously invalidated document

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Automatic email notification sent to assigned users and user groups upon document release

attributes.name: notification_sent
attributes.description: Confirmation that email was sent

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Workflow-supported request for document acknowledgement sent via email to recipients

attributes.name: recipient_count
attributes.description: Number of recipients requested to acknowledge

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Active confirmation of document acknowledgement by recipient without signature

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Creation of language-dependent version of released document requiring review and release

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: The language into which document is translated

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Workflow-supported review of translated document

attributes.name: review_result
attributes.description: Whether translation review was approved or rejected

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Final approval of translated version making it visible to authorized readers in that language

o2o.description: A Document can have Attachments that are released and archived with it
A Document can be supplemented with Additional Information
A Change Proposal belongs to and is displayed in a Document
A Document can have multiple Translations in different languages
A Document maintains a Distribution List for access and notification control
A User belongs to a User Group with shared permissions

o2e.description: A Document is created through the Create Document event
A Document is modified through the Edit Document event
A Document has metadata set through the Maintain Metadata event
A Document is converted to PDF through the Convert to PDF event
A Document enters review through the Initiate Review event
A Document review is completed through the Complete Review event
A Document enters release through the Initiate Release event
A Document is released through the Complete Release event
A Document is published through the Publish Document event
A Document creates a new version through the Create New Version event
A Document is signed through the Sign Document event
A Document validity extension is requested through the Request Validity Extension event
A Document validity is extended through the Extend Validity event
A Document override is requested through the Create Override Request event
A Document override is approved through the Approve Override event
A Document reactivation is requested through the Create Reactivation Request event
A Document is reactivated through the Approve Reactivation event
A Document is distributed through the Distribute by Email event
A Document acknowledgement is requested through the Request Acknowledgement event
A Document is translated through the Translate Document event
An Attachment is uploaded through the Upload Attachment event
An Attachment is archived through the Archive Attachment event
Additional Information is added through the Add Additional Information event
A Change Proposal is created through the Create Change Proposal event
A Translation is reviewed through the Review Translation event
A Translation is released through the Release Translation event
A User signs a Document through the Sign Document event
A User confirms acknowledgement through the Confirm Acknowledgement event
